correctness.rationale: First-step equations at five vertex orbits are correctly normalized for jump rate one and independently timed instantaneous reset at rate r. Eliminating the equations gives the stated exact rational mean for all integer a,b>=1 and real r>=0. The displayed positive second derivative proves strict convexity; endpoint derivative a-4b^2-3b+2 and positive limiting derivative give the sharp global optimizer partition. The fixed-a large-b limit follows by derivative convergence and bracketing. A separate Fraction Gaussian solver of the full labeled absorbing generator produced the exact formula in 100 cases (a,b=1..5, r in 0,1/5,2/3,7/4). Domain excludes alternate clocks, targets and reset mechanisms; the finite checker is not extrapolated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This leaf-to-leaf source/target pair has graph distance two for every parameter choice, but adding a remote trapped hub changes the optimal restarting decision sharply at a quadratic branching threshold; excessive local distractions can remove any restart benefit. For fixed local branching a, unreset first-passage time diverges linearly in the number b of remote trap leaves whereas the optimized mean remains bounded, and the exact optimizer tends to 1/sqrt(a+2). The exact rate response, unique optimizer and phase boundary give a motivated, reusable structural example of local versus remote trapping, not a choice of arbitrary finite parameters or a mere simulation.
